reasons.insults_others_generally: It labels everyone who disagrees as clueless and tells them to stop cooking, a broad personal put-down aimed at users generally.
reasons.moderation_action: The post contains a generalized insult but no named target; with no prior warnings and two reports, a civility note is proportionate.
reasons.rudeness_level: Calling disagreeing users clueless and telling them to stop cooking is clearly rude, though it is not threatening or highly abusive.
